description: Use this to schedule SEVERAL posts in ONE call, such as a week of content, instead of calling schedule_post once per post. `posts` is an array (up to 100); each entry takes exactly schedule_post’s fields (channels, at or useQueue, timezone, message, captions, imageUrl / videoUrl / imageUrls or a Library id, boardId, chatId, pageId, accounts, and every channel option schedule_post documents). Each post is checked and scheduled by the same rules as schedule_post, ON ITS OWN: the reply lists every post by index, scheduled (id, time, channels) or NOT scheduled (the reason), and a refused post never stops the others and is never left out. allOrNothing:true schedules none unless every post passes; dryRun:true only checks them. Costs no credits (X bills per call when it fires); the plan’s posting allowance counts every post in the batch. Upload local files first with upload_file.

allOrNothing.description: schedule none unless every post passes the check

dryRun.description: check every post and schedule nothing

posts.description: the posts, in order. Any other schedule_post field (visibility, privacyLevel, firstComment, altText, …) is accepted per post

accounts.description: which account(s) on a multi-account channel, as on schedule_post

at.description: when, as on schedule_post: local wall clock in `timezone` or the brand zone, or UTC (…Z)

channelOptions.description: rare per-channel extras: threadsChain[] / blueskyThread[] follow-ups threaded under it; linkedinPoll {question, options[], duration ONE_DAY|THREE_DAYS|SEVEN_DAYS|FOURTEEN_DAYS} a poll as the post; linkedinReshareOf repost this (link or urn); ytPlaylistId add to playlist; protectContent Telegram no forwarding/saving; telegramDocument file URL sent as the post; slackUsername / slackIconUrl / slackIconEmoji (:rocket:) the Slack app posts as that name and picture; sensitiveMedia [adult_content|graphic_violence|other] X media warning; geoRestriction {countries[] | excludeCountries[]} X media country limit (two-letter codes); textBackgroundPresetId Facebook text-only post on a coloured background (numeric preset id); tiktokLocationId + tiktokLocationName (search_tiktok_locations), tiktokMusicSoundId (songClipId from tiktok_ads_trending sounds), tiktokMusicVolume / tiktokOriginalSoundVolume 0-100, tiktokAdsOnly TikTok video as an ads-only post

channels.description: channels for THIS post, the same ids schedule_post takes

fit.description: as schedule_post’s fit: only on the user’s yes after a shape refusal, "pad" (true) or "crop" this post’s out-of-range photo

imageUrl.description: an image: an upload_file URL, a Hermoso render URL, or a Library id (L0)

message.description: the caption for every channel unless captions overrides it

pageId.description: which Facebook Page, when the brand has several

useQueue.description: the next free slot in a posting queue instead of `at`

videoUrl.description: a video: an upload_file URL, a Hermoso render URL, or a Library id

name: schedule_posts
title: Schedule several posts at once
